readingHtml:
The Great Flood of Marlowe

A story about a natural disaster

A.In the spring of 2023, heavy rain fell on the town of Marlowe for three days. The river in the town centre was usually calm, but the rain was too much. The water level rose quickly. On the third day, the river overflowed. Water covered the streets and entered the ground floors of many houses.

B.When the flood started, the local council told everyone to evacuate. Rescue teams used small boats to travel through the streets. They helped elderly people and children who were trapped in their homes. The water stayed in the town for a whole week.

C.After the water went down, the people of Marlowe began to clean up. The council provided free food and water. Now, the town is making a plan. They want to build new defences to protect the town from future floods.
